thought.text: Ruby 3.1.4 is installed. Now let me set up the environment and install dependencies.

reasoning_content:
Ruby 3.1.4 was built and installed to /usr/local/ruby. Next, set PATH. Let's add it to the profile and use it in the current shell. Also, install the pg gem which requires libpq-dev (already installed).

Now, let's set up the environment and install the gems.

action.command: echo 'export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH' >> /etc/profile.d/rbnode.sh && echo 'export GEM_HOME=' && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH && ruby --version && gem --version && which git && echo "PATH ok"
